subject.title: fix(channels): guard setup wizard text input trimming

question: Should OpenClaw accept strict `Required` behavior for malformed required setup prompt results, and is source/CI evidence enough or should maintainers capture/override live CLI proof first?
rationale: This is a public setup and credential behavior choice: the patch avoids a crash while deliberately failing closed for malformed required prompt results, and the bot-authored branch cannot supply contributor real-environment proof on its own.

options.title: Accept Strict Guard After Refresh
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, preserve wizard navigation, and land after maintainers accept strict required-input behavior plus the proof threshold.

options.title: Capture Live CLI Proof First
options.body: Require a redacted `openclaw onboard` or `openclaw channels add` token replacement run on the refreshed exact head before merge.

options.title: Wait For Another Candidate
options.body: Keep this paused only until another equivalent strict, proven, and mergeable fix replaces it; the current open alternative is not yet that safe target.

recommendation.title: Accept Strict Guard After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, preserve wizard navigation, and land after maintainers accept strict required-input behavior plus the proof threshold.

likelyOwner.reason: The setup wizard input-flow history is concentrated in his March refactors, and this decision affects the shared setup flow he introduced.
